messages:
Ivy: Quick note  my birthday is next Thursday morning. I'm terrible with surprises so low-key is fine, but if anyone wants to do a tiny morning thing (burritos? coffee? enamel pin?) that would be lovely.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post celebration plans in #people-ops. Sign-up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers. Suggested per-person contribution $5-20.
Ken: Burrito bar sounds iconic. I can swing by a breakfast place and pick up 12. Vegan + GF options ok?
Allegra: I'm remote but can send an enamel pin order link and chip in. Reaction poll: :taco: burritos, :coffee: coffee only, :pin: enamel pin, :two_hearts: donation.
Moksha: I'm in SF office that morning and can set up a tiny table with coffee urn + milk alternatives. Also happy to handle the card.
Ivy: No huge production please; burritos are fun though. If burritos win, early pickup ~8:30am and 9am quick micro-toast? Remote folks can drop a 5s clip.
people-ops-bot: people-ops notified  sign-up updated by Ken. Link: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers (last edit 1845678922).
Ken: Poll snapshot 9:10am PT: :taco: 7, :coffee: 2, :pin: 3, :two_hearts: 1  burritos lead. I'll order two vegan + one GF box.
Allegra: Pin option still open if folks want a small keepsake in addition to food. I can place an order for 10 pins and ship to office. Cost ~$6/pin.
Moksha: I'll make a 2-line card. Drop one-liners and I'll paste them in. Also reserving the pantry table 8:45-9:30am.
Ivy: Please no shouty songs. Gentle clapping encouraged. Also add "no cilantro please" for me lol.
Ken: Order placed: breakfast burritos 9am pick-up. ETA office 9:10am. Confirmed vegan & GF labeled.
Allegra: Pin order placed for 10 pins. ETA next week but I can give a mock pin sticker at the table.
Moksha: Card lines: "Happy birthday Ivy! May your deploys be green and your coffee always hot."
Allegra: "To Ivy: bringing calm to chaos since day one."
Ken: Quick logistics: remote folks, if you want to contribute $5 for burritos or $6 for pin, add on the sign-up sheet. I can collect Venmo.
people-ops-bot: Sign-up updated by Allegra. Last edit: 1845678990.
Ivy: You lot are ridiculous and also the best. See you Thursday morning (and if you bring cilantro I'll banish you to the async channel) :smile:
Moksha: Final plan: burrito mini-break 9:10am PT (pantry table), small coffee setup, pin mock sticker, card + optional pin order. Remote montage optional. Sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers.
